data.gender_notes: Avruch is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'aphros' (father) and 'chroos' (light). Avruch symbolizes the divine father figure, a beacon of wisdom and guidance. The name Avruch carries the meaning “Father of light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Avruch usually hope their child will grow to embody father of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name infused with divine light and paternal love.
data.etymology: Avruch belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avruch total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
